ja: • 12200系の増備車として1977年に登場したが、既に開発中だった30000系ビスタIIIの影響を受けた仕様の改良点が多く、別形式がつけられた。
• 前面は30000系に近く、12200系とは印象が異なる。
• 先頭車のみの２両セット。近鉄12200系Bセットと組み合わせることで４両編成の再現が可能。
• 前面パーツの組み合わせで12600系を作成可能。
・動力ユニット3対応・走行台車T対応・2両入り
en: • It was introduced in 1977 as an extension of the 12200 series, but there were many improvements in the specifications that were influenced by the 30000 series Vista III, which was already under development, and a different model was added.
• The front looks similar to the 30000 series and has a different impression from the 12200 series.
• 2-car set with only the lead car. By combining with Kintetsu 12200 series B set, it is possible to reproduce a 4-car train.
• 12600 series can be created by combining front parts.
・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
